WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    races.name,
    SUM(results.points) as total_points,
    AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps
  FROM results 
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.name,
    step1.total_points,
    step1.avg_laps,
    step1.total_points - step2.avg_total_points as difference
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.total_points > step2.avg_total_points
)
SELECT 
  SUM(step3.total_points) as sum_total_points,
  AVG(step3.avg_laps) as avg_avg_laps,
  AVG(step3.difference) as avg_difference
FROM step3
